proposal.type: ∀ m : Nat, 2 * (Finset.range m).sum (fun k => k) + m = m ^ 2

proposal.tactic:
intro m
induction m with
| zero => simp
| succ m ih =>
  rw [Finset.sum_range_succ]
  calc
    2 * ((Finset.range m).sum (fun k => k) + m) + (m + 1) =
        (2 * (Finset.range m).sum (fun k => k) + m) + (2 * m + 1) := by ring
    _ = (m + 1) ^ 2 := by rw [ih]; ring

proposals.tactic:
have hsum : ∀ m : Nat, 2 * (Finset.range m).sum (fun k => k) + m = m ^ 2 := by
  intro m
  induction m with
  | zero => norm_num [Finset.range_zero]
  | succ m ih =>
      rw [Finset.sum_range_succ]
      calc
        2 * ((Finset.range m).sum (fun k => k) + m) + (m + 1) =
            (2 * (Finset.range m).sum (fun k => k) + m) + (2 * m + 1) := by ring
        _ = (m + 1) ^ 2 := by rw [ih] <;> ring
induction n with
| zero => norm_num [Finset.range_zero]
| succ m ih =>
    rw [Finset.sum_range_succ, Finset.sum_range_succ, ih]
    calc
      ((Finset.range m).sum (fun k => k)) ^ 2 + m ^ 3 =
          ((Finset.range m).sum (fun k => k)) ^ 2 +
            m * (2 * (Finset.range m).sum (fun k => k) + m) := by
        rw [hsum m] <;> ring
      _ = ((Finset.range m).sum (fun k => k) + m) ^ 2 := by ring

  nlinarith only [ih]

induction n with
| zero => simp
| succ n ih =>
  simp only [Finset.sum_range_succ, ih]
  let s : Nat := Finset.sum (Finset.range n) (fun k => k)
  change s ^ 2 + n ^ 3 = (s + n) ^ 2
  have hs : 2 * s + n = n ^ 2 := hsum n
  calc
    s ^ 2 + n ^ 3 = s ^ 2 + n * (2 * s + n) := by
      rw [hs] <;> ring
    _ = (s + n) ^ 2 := by ring

  have h := congrArg (fun t : Nat => n * t) (hsum n)
